svg.title: Ramsey compactness prefix tree
svg.desc: A schematic two-colour prefix tree. Each node extends its parent's edge-colour sequence. The green path consists of nested compatible prefixes. Branches shown do not assert a particular edge enumeration or forbidden clique.
